name: 學術詞表 Sublist 9
description: Coxhead 學術詞表（AWL）第九級：學術文章中出現頻率次高的 60 個字族，適合累積雅思進階讀寫的精準用字。

words.definitionZh: 容納、提供空間；順應、配合（需求）

examples.sentence: The new lecture hall was designed to accommodate up to five hundred students.
examples.translationZh: 這間新講堂的設計可容納多達五百名學生。

words.definitionZh: 類比、比擬；兩者之間的相似之處

examples.sentence: The author draws an analogy between the human brain and a computer network.
examples.translationZh: 作者將人腦與電腦網路做了類比。

words.definitionZh: 預期、預料；預先因應

examples.sentence: Few economists anticipated how quickly the housing market would recover.
examples.translationZh: 很少有經濟學家預料到房市會這麼快復甦。

words.definitionZh: 向某人保證、使安心；確保

examples.sentence: The committee assured participants that all personal data would remain confidential.
examples.translationZh: 委員會向參與者保證，所有個人資料都會保密。

words.definitionZh: 達到、獲得（目標或水準）

examples.sentence: Only a minority of students attain the highest band in the writing test.
examples.translationZh: 只有少數學生能在寫作測驗中達到最高級分。

words.definitionZh: 代表、利益（常用於「代表某人」的片語）

examples.sentence: She accepted the research award on behalf of the entire laboratory.
examples.translationZh: 她代表整個實驗室領取這項研究獎。

words.definitionZh: 大部分、大量；龐大的體積

examples.sentence: The bulk of the funding was allocated to renewable energy projects.
examples.translationZh: 大部分的資金被分配給再生能源專案。

words.definitionZh: 停止、終止

examples.sentence: The factory ceased production after the new emissions rules took effect.
examples.translationZh: 在新的排放法規生效後，該工廠停止了生產。

words.definitionZh: 條理分明的、連貫的；前後一致的

examples.sentence: A high-scoring essay presents a coherent argument from start to finish.
examples.translationZh: 高分作文會從頭到尾呈現一個條理分明的論點。

words.definitionZh: 同時發生；（意見或看法）一致、吻合

examples.sentence: The decline in bird populations coincided with the expansion of intensive farming.
examples.translationZh: 鳥類數量的下降與集約農業的擴張同時發生。

words.definitionZh: 開始、著手（較正式的用法）

examples.sentence: Construction of the new campus library will commence next spring.
examples.translationZh: 新校園圖書館的工程將於明年春天開工。

words.definitionZh: 相容的、可並存的；合得來的

examples.sentence: Economic growth is not always compatible with environmental protection.
examples.translationZh: 經濟成長並非總是能與環境保護並存。

words.definitionZh: 同時發生的、並行的

examples.sentence: The conference ran three concurrent sessions on climate policy.
examples.translationZh: 這場研討會同時進行三場氣候政策的分場會議。

words.definitionZh: 限制於某範圍；關住、拘禁

examples.sentence: The study confined its analysis to households in urban areas.
examples.translationZh: 這項研究將分析限定在都市地區的家庭。

words.definitionZh: 爭議、論戰

examples.sentence: The proposal to charge tuition fees sparked considerable controversy.
examples.translationZh: 收取學費的提案引發了相當大的爭議。

words.definitionZh: 相反的情況；相反的；交談

examples.sentence: Wealthy nations pollute more, but the converse is true of vulnerability to climate damage.
examples.translationZh: 富裕國家污染較多，但在面對氣候損害的脆弱程度上情況正好相反。

words.definitionZh: 裝置、儀器；手法、策略

examples.sentence: Wearable devices allow doctors to monitor patients remotely.
examples.translationZh: 穿戴式裝置讓醫生能夠遠端監測病患。

words.definitionZh: 投入、奉獻（時間、心力或資源）

examples.sentence: She devoted ten years to researching endangered marine species.
examples.translationZh: 她投入十年時間研究瀕危的海洋物種。

words.definitionZh: 減少、降低；使變小、貶低

examples.sentence: Rural populations have diminished steadily over the past three decades.
examples.translationZh: 過去三十年間，鄉村人口持續減少。

words.definitionZh: 扭曲、曲解；使變形

examples.sentence: Selective use of statistics can seriously distort public understanding of an issue.
examples.translationZh: 選擇性地使用統計數據可能嚴重扭曲大眾對議題的理解。

words.definitionZh: 持續時間、期間

examples.sentence: Participants kept a sleep diary for the duration of the experiment.
examples.translationZh: 參與者在整個實驗期間都要記錄睡眠日誌。

words.definitionZh: 侵蝕、沖刷；逐漸削弱

examples.sentence: Rising sea levels are steadily eroding the coastline.
examples.translationZh: 海平面上升正持續侵蝕著海岸線。

words.definitionZh: 倫理、道德準則；（複數）道德規範

examples.sentence: The university requires all researchers to follow a strict code of ethics.
examples.translationZh: 這所大學要求所有研究人員遵守嚴格的倫理守則。

words.definitionZh: 格式、形式；設定格式、編排

examples.sentence: The exam has kept the same format for more than a decade.
examples.translationZh: 這項考試的形式已經維持了十多年不變。

words.definitionZh: 創立、建立；以某事物為基礎

examples.sentence: The institute was founded in 1948 to promote scientific cooperation.
examples.translationZh: 該研究所創立於一九四八年，旨在促進科學合作。

words.definitionZh: 固有的、與生俱來的；本質上存在的

examples.sentence: There are inherent risks in relying on a single source of energy.
examples.translationZh: 只依賴單一能源來源有其固有的風險。

words.definitionZh: 洞察、深入的理解；見解

examples.sentence: Interviews with migrants offered valuable insights into their daily struggles.
examples.translationZh: 對移民的訪談讓人深入了解他們日常生活的掙扎。

words.definitionZh: 不可或缺的、構成整體所必需的

examples.sentence: Fieldwork is an integral part of the geography curriculum.
examples.translationZh: 野外實察是地理課程中不可或缺的一環。

words.definitionZh: 中級的、中間的；居中的階段或事物

examples.sentence: Learners at an intermediate level often struggle with academic vocabulary.
examples.translationZh: 中級程度的學習者常常在學術詞彙上遇到困難。

words.definitionZh: 手動的、用手做的；使用手冊

examples.sentence: Automation has replaced much of the manual labour in the industry.
examples.translationZh: 自動化已取代了該產業中大部分的人力勞動。

words.definitionZh: 成熟的；成熟、發展完全

examples.sentence: Mature students often bring valuable work experience to the classroom.
examples.translationZh: 成年學生往往能把寶貴的工作經驗帶進課堂。

words.definitionZh: 調解、居中斡旋；作為中介影響結果

examples.sentence: The United Nations attempted to mediate between the two governments.
examples.translationZh: 聯合國試圖在兩國政府之間進行調解。

words.definitionZh: 媒介、傳播工具；中等的

examples.sentence: English has become the main medium of instruction in many universities.
examples.translationZh: 英語已成為許多大學的主要教學語言。

words.definitionZh: 軍事的、軍隊的；軍方

examples.sentence: Many technologies we use daily were originally developed for military purposes.
examples.translationZh: 許多我們日常使用的科技最初是為了軍事用途而開發的。

words.definitionZh: 最小的、極少的

examples.sentence: The new policy had minimal impact on household spending.
examples.translationZh: 這項新政策對家庭支出的影響極小。

words.definitionZh: 相互的、彼此的；共同的

examples.sentence: Successful collaboration depends on mutual trust between the two teams.
examples.translationZh: 成功的合作取決於兩個團隊之間的相互信任。

words.definitionZh: 常態、標準；社會規範

examples.sentence: Remote working has become the norm in many technology companies.
examples.translationZh: 遠距工作在許多科技公司已成為常態。

words.definitionZh: 重疊、部分相同；重疊之處

examples.sentence: There is considerable overlap between the two research fields.
examples.translationZh: 這兩個研究領域之間有相當大的重疊。

words.definitionZh: 被動的、消極的；不主動的

examples.sentence: Lectures encourage passive learning unless students are asked to participate.
examples.translationZh: 除非要求學生參與，否則講課容易造成被動學習。

words.definitionZh: 部分、一份；份量

examples.sentence: A large portion of the city's waste is still sent to landfill.
examples.translationZh: 該市有很大一部分的垃圾仍被送往掩埋場。

words.definitionZh: 初步的、預備的；初步階段

examples.sentence: Preliminary results suggest that the treatment reduces recovery time.
examples.translationZh: 初步結果顯示這種療法能縮短恢復時間。

words.definitionZh: 規約、作業程序；外交禮儀

examples.sentence: All laboratories must follow the same safety protocol.
examples.translationZh: 所有實驗室都必須遵守相同的安全作業程序。

words.definitionZh: 質性的、質化的（與數量相對）

examples.sentence: The study combined qualitative interviews with large-scale survey data.
examples.translationZh: 這項研究結合了質性訪談與大規模的問卷數據。

words.definitionZh: 改良、精進；提煉、精製

examples.sentence: The team refined its model after reviewing the first round of data.
examples.translationZh: 團隊在檢視第一輪數據後改良了他們的模型。

words.definitionZh: 放鬆、休息；放寬（規定或限制）

examples.sentence: The government relaxed visa requirements to attract international students.
examples.translationZh: 政府放寬了簽證規定以吸引國際學生。

words.definitionZh: 抑制、遏止；約束、限制

examples.sentence: Higher interest rates are intended to restrain consumer spending.
examples.translationZh: 提高利率的用意在於抑制消費者支出。

words.definitionZh: 革命、劇烈變革；旋轉一圈

examples.sentence: The digital revolution has transformed the way information is shared.
examples.translationZh: 數位革命已徹底改變了資訊分享的方式。

words.definitionZh: 僵化的、不知變通的；堅硬不易彎曲的

examples.sentence: A rigid timetable leaves teachers little room to respond to students' needs.
examples.translationZh: 僵化的課表讓教師幾乎沒有空間回應學生的需求。

words.definitionZh: 路線、途徑；安排路線、轉送

examples.sentence: Vocational training offers an alternative route into the profession.
examples.translationZh: 職業訓練提供了進入這個行業的另一條途徑。

words.definitionZh: 情境、設想的狀況；可能的發展

examples.sentence: In the worst-case scenario, global temperatures could rise by four degrees.
examples.translationZh: 在最壞的情況下，全球氣溫可能上升四度。

words.definitionZh: 領域、範疇；球體

examples.sentence: Women have gained greater influence in the political sphere.
examples.translationZh: 女性在政治領域已獲得更大的影響力。

words.definitionZh: 次要的、從屬的；部屬；使居次要地位

examples.sentence: In this model, economic goals are subordinate to environmental ones.
examples.translationZh: 在這個模式中，經濟目標次於環境目標。

words.definitionZh: 補充物、增補；補充、增添

examples.sentence: Many students supplement their income with part-time work.
examples.translationZh: 許多學生靠打工來補貼收入。

words.definitionZh: 暫停、中止；懸掛

examples.sentence: The trial was suspended until further safety data became available.
examples.translationZh: 這項試驗被暫停，直到取得更多安全數據為止。

words.definitionZh: 團隊、隊伍；合作、組隊

examples.sentence: A team of engineers spent two years testing the prototype.
examples.translationZh: 一組工程師花了兩年時間測試這個原型。

words.definitionZh: 暫時的、短期的

examples.sentence: The shelter provides temporary housing for families affected by flooding.
examples.translationZh: 這處收容所為受洪水影響的家庭提供暫時住所。

words.definitionZh: 引發、觸發；起因、扳機

examples.sentence: Deforestation can trigger severe soil erosion within a few years.
examples.translationZh: 濫伐森林可能在幾年內引發嚴重的土壤流失。

words.definitionZh: 統一、使成為一體

examples.sentence: The reform aims to unify assessment standards across all state schools.
examples.translationZh: 這項改革旨在統一所有公立學校的評量標準。

words.definitionZh: 違反、違背（法律或規定）；侵犯

examples.sentence: The company was fined for violating environmental regulations.
examples.translationZh: 該公司因違反環保法規而遭到罰款。

words.definitionZh: 視力、視覺；願景、遠見

examples.sentence: The mayor outlined her vision for a car-free city centre.
examples.translationZh: 市長闡述了她對無車市中心的願景。
